ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a parallelogram, with vertices labeled in order as M, N, P, Q, where M is at the upper left, N is at the upper right, P is at the lower right, and Q is at the lower left; M and N are adjacent vertices on the same upper side. The problem statement gives m∠M = 10x, m∠N = 20x. Reasoning: In a parallelogram, adjacent interior angles are supplementary, so ∠M + ∠N = 180°. Therefore 10x + 20x = 180, giving 30x = 180, x = 6. Thus ∠N = 20x = 20 × 6 = 120°.
